workbook: 4. Appendix-II MYT Tariff Formats ARR FY 2026-27.xlsx
note: F24 depreciation by asset class, FY2026-27 (rows 122–140): the year's depreciation of each class (G) is NPCL's figure — given, never counted as reproduced; closing gross block (E) and closing accumulated depreciation (I) from the opening, additions and deductions; the rate the year's figure implies (J); the total (G141), less the depreciation on consumer-contribution assets (G144, printed negative), is the net (G145) the ARR format carries (ARR!M36).

blank_is_zero.why: classes with nothing (capital spares, spare units, assets not belonging to the utility) leave cells blank; NPCL's SUMs read the blanks as zero

record:gfa_grants.why: F24 has no grants column per class; grants would be deducted below the total ('Less: Grants', blank)

record:dep_contribution.why: the format prints the deduction negative
